results.question: Can I work from my hometown in Kerala for three weeks?
failures: answer: missing 'already used|remaining|left this year|balance|not used'
results.answer: Yes, if you are a confirmed employee (as employees on probation must work from the office full time) [3], you can work from another city in India for up to 30 days a year with your manager's approval [1]. Since Kerala is in India and three weeks is under the 30-day limit, this is permitted under those conditions [1][3].

results.question: One of my reports got a rating of 1. What happens to them, and what increment do they get?
results.answer: An employee rated 1 is placed on a 60-day performance improvement plan with documented, measurable goals, which requires the HR business partner to be involved from the start and the manager to hold check-ins every two weeks [1]. Additionally, managers must bring written evidence for a rating of 1 to the calibration meeting [5]. Regarding their salary, an employee with a rating of 1 receives no annual increment [3].
